import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem iterated_periodicity (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < a)
  (h₁ : ∀ x, f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - f x ^ 2)) :
  ∀ x (n : ℕ), f (x + (n : ℝ) * (2 * a)) = f x := by
  have hT_bounds :
      ∀ y : ℝ,
        1 / 2 ≤ 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2) ∧
        1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have hsqrt_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hsqrt_le : Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      by_cases hrad : 0 ≤ y - y ^ 2
      · have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) ^ 2 = y - y ^ 2 :=
          Real.sq_sqrt hrad
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - 1 / 2)]
      · have hzero : Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2) = 0 :=
          Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hrad)
        rw [hzero]
        norm_num
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hf_bounds : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have hx :
        f x = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - f (x - a) ^ 2) := by
      convert h₁ (x - a) using 1 <;> ring
    rw [hx]
    exact hT_bounds (f (x - a))
  
  have h_involution :
      ∀ y : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ y → y ≤ 1 →
        1 / 2 + Real.sqrt
            ((1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) -
              (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) ^ 2) = y := by
    intro y hy_lower hy_upper
    have hy_rad : 0 ≤ y - y ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) ^ 2 = y - y ^ 2 :=
      Real.sq_sqrt hy_rad
    have hrad :
        (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) -
            (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (y - y ^ 2)) ^ 2 =
          (y - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    rw [hrad, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
    · ring
    · linarith
  
  have hperiod_two : ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + 2 * a) = f x := by
    intro x
    calc
      f (x + 2 * a) =
          1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - f (x + a) ^ 2) := by
            convert h₁ (x + a) using 1 <;> ring
      _ = f x := by
        rw [h₁ x]
        exact h_involution (f x) (hf_bounds x).1 (hf_bounds x).2
  
  intro x n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        f (x + (↑(Nat.succ n) : ℝ) * (2 * a)) =
            f ((x + (n : ℝ) * (2 * a)) + 2 * a) := by
              congr 1
              push_cast
              ring
        _ = f (x + (n : ℝ) * (2 * a)) := hperiod_two _
        _ = f x := ih
